Fiscal Year 2026-27 Departmental Budget Presentations
Pursuant to Section 252⁄3 of the County Charter, as amended by the Measure G Charter Amendment (as approved by voters in the November 5, 2024 General Election), Department Head presentations to the Board of Supervisors by the following departments of their Fiscal Year 2026-27 budget requests:
- Public Social Services
- Children and Family Services 
- Aging and Disabilities
- Military and Veteran Affairs 
- Child Support Services 
- Economic Opportunity 
- Consumer and Business Affairs 
- Internal Services
- Human Resources
- County Counsel Registrar
- Recorder/County Clerk 
- Arts and Culture
- Museum of Art
- Museum of Natural History
